name: The Gates
s: Nick Monohan and his family move from Chicago to a quiet, upscale planned community called The Gates , where he will be chief of police. They soon realize that their neighbors are not who they seem to be. The Gates is filled with such beings as vampires, witches, werewolves, and a succubus.

paragraphs.text: The Gates is an American supernatural crime drama television series that aired on the ABC network from June 20, 2010, to September 19, 2010. The show was cancelled after its first season due to low ratings.

Soon after the first season finished airing there were rumors that the show would not be returning for a second season. These rumors were further fueled by cast member Grillo's tweets suggesting that his contract was not going to be renewed. In October 2010 several of the show's stars confirmed that the show had indeed been canceled and that there would not be a second season.
